scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.share: npm run build && concurrently -n app,tunnel -c green,magenta "npm start" "npx --yes localtunnel --port 3001"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:cf
scripts.deploy:cf:temp: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@latest deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml --temporary
